environment: Node 24.19, Python 3 (-I via pycall), git; scratch repos from cli-runner; slice worktree at sdlc/S-019

cases.title: list and name give the next run branch for 0, 1 and 3 run branches
cases.given: scratch repos with 0, 1, 3 run branches under five formats
cases.when: list --kind run, then name --kind run --n count+1, then parse
cases.then: the list count equals the branches made; the new name parses as run with n=count+1; no tree change
cases.expected: the list count equals the branches made; the new name parses as run with n=count+1; no tree change
cases.actual: the list count equals the branches made; the new name parses as run with n=count+1; no tree change Observed.

cases.title: A run branch from another format is not counted
cases.then: each format lists only its own run branches; an unrelated format lists none
cases.expected: each format lists only its own run branches; an unrelated format lists none
cases.actual: each format lists only its own run branches; an unrelated format lists none Observed.

cases.title: Hostile --format values fail with JSON error and leave the tree unchanged
cases.given: 11 hostile formats (flag-like, traversal, double placeholder, none, empty, whitespace, newline)
cases.then: exit 0 or 2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, no unsafe branch value, tree unchanged
cases.expected: exit 0 or 2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, no unsafe branch value, tree unchanged
cases.actual: exit 0 or 2, JSON on stdout, no Traceback, no unsafe branch value, tree unchanged Observed.

cases.title: Property: list is numerically sorted and the last entry holds the highest n
cases.given: 1000 random branch sets, n up to 5000, noise branches, five formats
cases.when: list_kind through the module entry against a reference model written from the spec
cases.then: sorted ascending by integer n; last entry is max n; noise excluded
cases.expected: sorted ascending by integer n; last entry is max n; noise excluded
cases.actual: sorted ascending by integer n; last entry is max n; noise excluded Observed.

cases.title: Example: runs 2, 9, 10, 11 end at 11; empty repo lists nothing; name for n=11 equals the existing branch
cases.then: order 2,9,10,11; last sdlc/run-11; name equals it; empty list on no run branch; no tree change
cases.expected: order 2,9,10,11; last sdlc/run-11; name equals it; empty list on no run branch; no tree change
cases.actual: order 2,9,10,11; last sdlc/run-11; name equals it; empty list on no run branch; no tree change Observed.

cases.title: Property: parse of a run branch name returns run with the same n
cases.given: 1000 random formats and n up to 100000
cases.actual: kind run and n equal Observed.

cases.title: feature/PROJ-1-S-002 parses as slice S-002; feature/PROJ-1-foo has no kind
cases.then: kind slice id S-002 exit 0 stderr empty; kind null exit 0
cases.expected: kind slice id S-002 exit 0 stderr empty; kind null exit 0
cases.actual: kind slice id S-002 exit 0 stderr empty; kind null exit 0 Observed.

cases.title: Regex characters in the prefix are literal; repeated or shifted prefix is not a kind
cases.then: literal match gives slice; look-alike branches, repeated prefix, case changes, empty tail give null
cases.expected: literal match gives slice; look-alike branches, repeated prefix, case changes, empty tail give null
cases.actual: literal match gives slice; look-alike branches, repeated prefix, case changes, empty tail give null Observed.

cases.title: Exit codes and stderr are stable
cases.given: missing --branch, format without placeholder, repeated call
cases.then: exit 2 with ok false JSON for bad input; same stdout on repeat
cases.expected: exit 2 with ok false JSON for bad input; same stdout on repeat
cases.actual: exit 2 with ok false JSON for bad input; same stdout on repeat Observed.

cases.title: Bullet order in SKILL.md
cases.then: Worktree path before Git mode and Branch format; Branch format before Run worktree before specPath before STOP removal; one WT assignment; the mismatch sentence sits only in Run worktree
cases.expected: Worktree path before Git mode and Branch format; Branch format before Run worktree before specPath before STOP removal; one WT assignment; the mismatch sentence sits only in Run worktree
cases.actual: Worktree path before Git mode and Branch format; Branch format before Run worktree before specPath before STOP removal; one WT assignment; the mismatch sentence sits only in Run worktree Observed.

cases.title: Run worktree bullet content
cases.then: RUN_BRANCH command, count rule, relaunch rule, checkout, no new branch on relaunch, mismatch sentence, no literal sdlc/run-<n>
cases.expected: RUN_BRANCH command, count rule, relaunch rule, checkout, no new branch on relaunch, mismatch sentence, no literal sdlc/run-<n>
cases.actual: RUN_BRANCH command, count rule, relaunch rule, checkout, no new branch on relaunch, mismatch sentence, no literal sdlc/run-<n> Observed.

cases.title: Quoted commands run as written in a scratch repo
cases.when: run the quoted list and name commands, create the worktree, add run-9 and run-10, detach HEAD, run the quoted checkout
cases.then: empty list then feature/run-1; worktree add succeeds; relaunch list ends with feature/run-10; no new run branch; checkout puts HEAD back on feature/run-10
cases.expected: empty list then feature/run-1; worktree add succeeds; relaunch list ends with feature/run-10; no new run branch; checkout puts HEAD back on feature/run-10
cases.actual: empty list then feature/run-1; worktree add succeeds; relaunch list ends with feature/run-10; no new run branch; checkout puts HEAD back on feature/run-10 Observed.

seeds.title: parse accepts a trailing newline in the branch
seeds.detail: parse("feature/PROJ-1-{name}", "feature/PROJ-1-S-002\n") returns kind slice because Python $ matches before a final newline. Git cannot hold such a name, so the risk is low. Use fullmatch or \Z.
